caseNameFull: Thompson, Trustee v. Terminal Shares, Inc.

opinions.text:

Mr. B. B. Caldwell for petitioner. Mr. William B. Cockley for Terminal Shares,. Inc. et al.; Messrs. Godfrey Goldmark and Henry N. Ess for Guaranty Trust Co. et ah; and Messrs. Clan Cramford, Benj.
